title: bb_analyze: descriptor, validation layer and handler describe one contract

checks.name: bb_analyze is registered as a public tool
modes are exactly the 11 the handler implements
parameters are exactly filePath, limit, mode, target
mode enum equals the registered modes
limit is declared as a number
descriptor defaults name the real per-mode defaults
checks.detail: {"limit":"25 edges per direction (callers/callees/trace); 20 files (dependencies); 50 entries (test_mapping/test_gaps); 50 files (test_quality)","target":"required for callers, callees, trace, impact, test_impact; optional file path or directory prefix for complexity","filePath":"optional path prefix (or an exact file) for dependencies, test_mapping, test_gaps, test_quality"}

checks.name: validation layer accepts the aliases the descriptor documents
validation rejects an unknown option

checks.name: validation rejects an unknown mode
checks.detail: bb_analyze: mode must be one of: callers, callees, trace, dependencies, stats, complexity, impact, test_mapping, test_gaps, test_impact, test_quality

checks.name: validation rejects conflicting alias and canonical
checks.detail: bb_analyze: target and symbol are aliases with different values ("a" vs "b") — pass one
